description: Source code for the OA_Creative_File class, which handles uploaded creative files in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for loading, validating, and processing image and media files, as well as factory methods for creating instances from files, strings, or uploads.

classes.name: OA_Creative_File
classes.description: Class for managing uploaded creative files, including images and rich media, with methods for loading, validating, and creating instances from various sources.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a filename.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads the content of a file and reads its creative details.

methods.name: checkSize
methods.description: Checks if a file size exceeds the maximum allowed size, throws RuntimeException if it does.

methods.name: readCreativeDetails
methods.description: Reads image size and format details from a file.

methods.name: getFileDetails
methods.description: Returns an array with filename, dimensions, content type, and plugin version.

methods.name: getContentTypeByExtension
methods.description: Returns content type based on file extension.

methods.name: staticGetContentTypeByExtension
methods.description: Static method to determine content type from filename extension.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates an instance from a file path and filename, determining type based on extension.

methods.name: factoryString
methods.description: Creates an instance from filename and content string.

methods.name: factoryUploadedFile
methods.description: Creates an instance from an uploaded file variable.
